;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020)]]
**[[Turkey]] calls for the establishment of a [[no-fly zone]] over [[Syria]]. [https://www.yenisafak.com/en/news/turkey-says-world-powers-must-impose-no-fly-zone-in-syria-3512927 (''Yeni Safak'')]
**[[NATO]] holds an emergency meeting after Turkey formally triggers [[North Atlantic Treaty#Article 4|Article 4]] of the [[North Atlantic Treaty]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2020/02/27/at-least-22-turkish-soliders-killed-in-syria-airstrike (Euronews)]
**Turkish [[Ministry of National Defense (Turkey)|MoD]] states that last night 329 [[Syrian Army]] troops were "neutralized" and asserts that five [[Military helicopter|helicopters]], 23 [[tank]]s, 10 [[Armored fighting vehicle|armored vehicles]], 23 [[artillery]] and [[howitzer]]s, five ammunition trucks, one [[Buk missile system|SA-17]] and one [[Pantsir missile system|SA-22]] air defense systems, three ammunition depots, two inventory depots and one headquarters building belonging to Syria's military were destroyed. [https://www.ntv.com.tr/turkiye/bakan-akardan-idlib-aciklamasi-200u-askin-rejim-hedefi-agir-ates-altina-alindi,awStSE9uBkygl8uGfj5JKQ (NTV)]
**[[Russia]] deploys two [[Frigate|frigates]], [[Russian frigate Admiral Makarov|''Admiral Makarov'']] and [[Russian frigate Admiral Grigorovich|''Admiral Grigorovich'']], armed with [[3M-54 Kalibr|Kalibr cruise missiles]] to the [[Eastern Mediterranean]] off the Syrian coast. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security-russia/russia-sends-warships-to-syria-blames-ankara-for-killing-of-turkish-troops-idUKKCN20M0LZ (Reuters)] [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/02/28/russia-sends-warships-as-turkish-troops-killed-in-syria-a69443 (''The Moscow Times'')]
**Turkey deploys [[MIM-23 Hawk]] [[surface-to-air missile]]s to its [[Syria–Turkey border|border with Syria]]. [https://www.star.com.tr/savunma/turkiyenin-hawk-hava-savunma-sistemleri-yonunu-suriyeye-cevrildi-haber-1518798/ (STAR)]
**A Turkish [[drone strike]] kills 11 Syrian government soldiers on the M5 highway near Idlib. [http://www.syriahr.com/?p=365871 (SOHR)]
**Syrian attacks on Marat al-Nasan leave more Turkish soldiers wounded, some of them seriously. [http://www.syriahr.com/?p=365800 (SOHR)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Roman Polanski]] wins three [[César Award]]s, also for best [[film director|director]], for his movie ''[[An Officer and a Spy (film)|An Officer and a Spy]]'' (French: ''J'accuse''). Several women walk out in protest. ''[[Les Misérables (2019 film)|Les Misérables]]'' wins four Césars, one of them for best film. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-awards-cesars/polanski-win-at-cesars-would-send-wrong-message-in-metoo-era-minister-idUSKCN20M1P1 (Reuters)] [https://variety.com/2020/film/news/cesar-awards-winners-2020-polanski-protests-1203519255/ (''Variety'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**Global stock markets have lost [[United States dollar|US$]]6 trillion in value over the last six days. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/02/28/global-stock-markets-have-lost-6-trillion-in-value-in-six-days.html (CNBC)]
**The [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]] drops 800 points at opening, continuing the worst week since the [[financial crisis of 2007–08]]. This week, the [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]] has dropped 13% and 4,000 points. [https://www.msnbc.com/stephanie-ruhle/watch/dow-drops-800-at-open-extending-worst-week-since-financial-crisis-79609925841 (MSNBC)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/business/markets/wall-street-rout-continues-seventh-day-dow-falls-800-points-n1144791 (NBC News)]
**The [[Geneva Motor Show]] is cancelled due to the Swiss ban on gatherings larger than 1000 people.  [https://www.foxnews.com/auto/geneva-motor-show-cancelled-due-to-coronavirus-concerns (Fox News)]
**The [[ITB Berlin]], the world's largest tourism trade fair, is cancelled after authorities imposed the restriction that each participant would have to prove they are not a risk. [https://www.itb-berlin.de/en/Extrapages/HealthInfo/ (ITB Berlin)]
*American investment management firm [[Elliott Management Corporation]] buys a significant stake in [[Twitter]], and announces it will seek to make several changes to their management, including possibly replacing CEO [[Jack Dorsey]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/amp/news/articles/2020-02-29/singer-s-elliott-is-said-to-seek-to-replace-twitter-ceo-dorsey?__twitter_impression=true (Bloomberg)] 

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
***464 more coronavirus cases are confirmed in [[Italy]], bringing the number to 888. Four more virus-related deaths are confirmed, bringing the death toll in the country to 21. [https://www.ilsole24ore.com/art/coronavirus-situazione-in-tempo-reale-italia-ACtOUfMB?refresh_ce=1 (''Il Sole 24 Ore'')]
**[[Belarus]], [[Monaco]], [[Iceland]], [[Azerbaijan]], [[New Zealand]], [[Lithuania]], [[Mexico]] and [[Nigeria]] confirm their first cases of coronavirus. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2020/02/the-latest-coronavirus-cases/ (BNO News)]
**[[Cyprus]] closes four of its [[Border checkpoint|checkpoints]] along the border with [[Northern Cyprus]] for the first time since 2003 due to coronavirus concerns. The checkpoints are expected to be reopened within a week. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-health-cyprus-checkpoints/cyprus-to-shut-checkpoints-for-first-time-since-2003-over-coronavirus-idUSKCN20M1T6?il=0 (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020)]], [[European migrant crisis]]
**Nearly 300 [[Immigration|migrants]] including [[Syria|Syrians]] arrived in [[Edirne province]], [[Turkey]], on the border with [[Greece]] in a bid to go to [[Europe]]. Another group of migrants arrived on the coast of [[Ayvacık, Çanakkale|Ayvacik]] in [[Çanakkale]], western Turkey, and wanted to go to the Greek island of [[Lesbos]] by boats. Turkish officials announced that the security forces will not intervene to prevent the crossing of any migrants, including those from Syria and other countries like [[Afghanistan]] and [[Iran]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/20200228-turkey-says-will-not-stop-refugees-who-want-to-go-to-europe (France 24)] [https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/hundreds-of-migrants-walk-toward-turkeys-border-with-greece-to-reach-europe/news (''Daily Sabah'')]

**Chinese [[Swimming at the Summer Olympics|Olympic Swimmer]] [[Sun Yang]] is banned from swimming for eight years after being found guilty of doping by the [[Court of Arbitration for Sport]]. [https://www.news.com.au/sport/olympics/sun-yang-doping-case-chinese-swimmers-fate-decided/news-story/c634e9c0040e9d72568d5f57b8be30e2 (News AU)]
*[[Immigration policy of the first Donald Trump administration|Immigration policy of Donald Trump]]
**The [[United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit|9th Circuit Court of Appeals]] in [[San Francisco]] temporarily block the [[Immigration policy of the first Donald Trump administration|Remain-in-Mexico policy]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/appeals-court-temporarily-blocks-key-remain-in-mexico-policy (Fox News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Guinean legislative election]]
**[[Guinea]]'s [[List of presidents of Guinea|president]] [[Alpha Condé]] announces a postponement of both the general election and referendum slated for March 1. A new date isn't given yet. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-51689308 (BBC News)]
*[[2019–20 Hong Kong protests]]
**[[Hong Kong Police Force|Hong Kong Police]] arrest entrepreneur [[Jimmy Lai]], owner of the newspaper ''[[Apple Daily]]'', and former lawmakers [[Yeung Sum]] and [[Lee Cheuk-yan]] for their involvement in anti-government protests. [https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/politics/article/3052789/hong-kong-protests-apple-daily-owner-jimmy-lai-arrested (''SCMP'')] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/hong-kong-arrest-lai-1.5479337 (CBC)] [https://www.cnn.com/2020/02/28/media/hong-kong-jimmy-lai-arrest-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
